props.name: src
props.description: The media. Any <video> attribute is accepted and forwarded.

props.name: kind
props.description: Audio swaps the picture for a placeholder with the title, and drops the full-screen button — there is nothing to enlarge.

props.name: title
props.description: Shown over the video and used as the accessible name of the control group when it is a string. It deliberately shadows the HTML title attribute: a tooltip on a player is not what you want.

props.name: poster
props.description: Still frame before playback. Video only.

props.name: children
props.description: Where <track> elements go. Captions are read from the element's textTracks, so the CC button appears only when a track actually exists.

props.name: onPlay
props.description: Your media handlers are COMPOSED with the internal ones, never replacing them — the same holds for onPause, onEnded, onTimeUpdate, onLoadedMetadata, onDurationChange, onProgress and onVolumeChange. An external onPlay that replaced ours would leave the button reading "Play" during playback.
